drafts.caption:

See the game and play free: https://mythicalvoid.com/playable-now/

drafts.headline: The Void is waiting.
drafts.caption:
Mythical Void is a free early-access creature adventure from an independent Irish studio. Players hatch a genetically varied alien creature, explore six living realms, clear the corruption holding their guardians and choose what Project Beacon should become.

Watch real gameplay and start in your browser: https://mythicalvoid.com/playable-now/
